resolved.title: 数组操作
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Operations[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

It is easy to perform basic mathematical operations with arrays. 
For example, to find the sum of all elements, we use the [b]sum[/b]() function:[code format="py" codeId="3222"]x = np.arange(1, 10)

print(x.sum()) [/code]
Similarly, [b]min[/b]() and [b]max[/b]() can be used to get the smallest and largest elements.
 
We can also perform operations between the array and a single number. 
For example, we can multiply all elements by 2:[code format="py" codeId="3223"]x = np.arange(1, 10)
y = x*2 [/code]
As simple as that! Take your array and perform any operation you want with it!
[note]NumPy understands that the given operation should be performed with each element. This is called [b]broadcasting[/b].[/note]

Remember the summary statistics we learned in the previous module? Those included [b]mean[/b], [b]median[/b], [b]variance[/b] and [b]standard deviation[/b].

print(np.median(x))
print(np.var(x))
print(np.std(x)) [/code]
[note]As you can see, [b]NumPy[/b] provides many useful functions to perform common operations with arrays.[/note]

还记得我们在上一章节学习的汇总统计吗？其中包括**平均数mean**，**中位数median**，**方差var**和**标准差std**。

NumPy数组有内置函数来返回这些值：
content.text_html:
Remember the summary statistics we learned in the previous module? Those included mean, median, variance and standard deviation.

NumPy arrays have built-in functions to return those values.

还记得我们在上一单元学习的汇总统计吗？其中包括平均数，中位数，差异和标准差。

NumPy数组有内置函数来返回这些值。

x = np.array([14, 18, 19, 24, 26, 33, 42, 55, 67])

# 平均数
print(np.mean(x))
# 中位数
print(np.median(x))
# 方差
print(np.var(x))
 # 标准差
print(np.std(x))

resolved.title: 新冠感染
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定数组表示30天内的每日新冠感染的人数。
计算输出有多少天超过了30天内**平均**感染数。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Daily Infections[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The given array represents the daily number of infections for 30 days.
Find out how many days exceeded the [b]average[/b] number of infections.
[note]Create the condition and output the size of the resulting array.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 创建条件并输出结果数组的大小。

import numpy as np

data = np.array([120, 98, 150, 65, 42, 100, 190, 220,
 140, 110, 88, 89, 100, 120, 50, 180, 155, 42, 89, 77, 200, 190, 125, 98,
 77, 40, 39, 59, 30, 67])

mean = np.mean(data)

counter = 0

for i in data:
 if i>mean:
  counter+=1

print(counter)
